- Root cause hypothesis: kernel selection falls back to quantized kernels when JVM memory pressure crosses a threshold for the serving process. The quantized path has lower warmup but higher variance at long sequence lengths in our test harness.
- Evidence: attached CSV includes request latencies and per-host memory metrics aligned with the two 504s.

Immediate remediation we recommend:
- Force routing to the high-precision variant for GreenGrid test traffic for 36 hours (Owner: Neha Kapoor).
- Increase KV cache pool size on the affected hosts by +15% (Owner: Monica Patel) — ETA: 12 hours, no restart required.
- Run the kernel selection stress test (Owner: Monica Patel) — ETA: 48 hours; will produce a small regression report.
